objective: Pair every V443 development response with the teacher response and frozen evaluator to determine whether a concrete prompt-fidelity failure owns a majority of candidate-specific losses.

population.identity: exact probe_id intersection among the frozen validation catalog, teacher T0 outputs, and V443 outputs

owner_definition: A candidate-specific failure is prompt-literal fidelity when the teacher passes, V443 fails, an evaluator literal occurs verbatim in the supplied prompt, and that literal is absent from V443 output. Regex failures, abstention failures, and all remaining failures are counted separately.
decision_rule: If all gates pass, prompt-literal carriage is a measured material owner and one bounded sparse pointer-carriage successor using the frozen V443 candidate may be designed. Otherwise no pointer successor is authorized. This attribution cannot change any functional score or promote V443.
audit_limitations: The paired counts and owner rule were inspected before freezing this protocol. This is transparent development attribution for experiment selection, not an independent confirmatory result.
claim_boundary: Read-only development attribution only; no quality, architecture, runtime, final-test, promotion, certification, or superiority claim.
